anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Marcus Dubois. From Stonebridge." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Sofia Ortiz. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
